title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains the spoken sentence “Das sieht nicht gut aus.” despite the explicit no-talking requirement.
An extra line of garbled, unreadable text appears beneath the closing “Shop now” message.
A partial white marking appears on the bottle in the 9.4-second close-up, unlike the plain black surface in the reference.
The product imagery is noticeably soft, particularly around the lid and bottle edges.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical studio ad includes the correct opening and closing text and a recognizable bottle, but unwanted speech and garbled closing text prevent use as delivered.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is identified as one 15-second MP4, and the frames have a 9:16 portrait format.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The black cylindrical body, shaped shoulders, broad screw cap, and raised loop-style lid broadly match the reference, although an extraneous white marking appears in one close-up.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show full-product views and differently oriented lid close-ups against a clean light-gray studio background.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: Both requested phrases are clearly readable and correctly spelled in the opening and closing samples.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription explicitly reports spoken German; the mood or presence of music cannot be established from the transcription.
